sentences.en: The public at large are dissatisfied with the present government.
sentences.zh: 公众普遍对当前政府感到不满。

sentences.en: And our council is the local government for our area.
sentences.zh: 我们的委员会就是我们地区的当地政府。

sentences.en: The Diet is the chief organ of government in Japan.
sentences.zh: 日本国会是日本的主要政府部门。

senses.zh: 政府治理的形式；政体治理，统治形容词:governmental
